_doc: captions.json for the booth-trailer template -> copy to scenes/captions.json (new-film does this).
Lane style keynote (the skin's captions.style: skins/ember.json); the hero question in karaoke (the spoken word lights up,
accent + bold cross-fade without reflow, 1.06 pulse); the closing line kinetic (word waterfall 0.06 s x 0.84^i <= 0.3 s, block
exit); title and close cards drop (their words are already on screen - captioning them twice is text-on-text).
karaoke on <= 2 phases per film; kinetic on recreated lines only. Everything here is fictional (Acme).
Keep this file (and captions_overrides.json if you add one) in qa.json 'authored' so display substitutions pass the text gates.
